description: List events for a sport (default window: the next 14 days, max 5000 per response). Call get_sports and get_leagues first for slugs. Returns id, home, away, homeId, awayId, date, status, sport, league and scores; use the id with get_odds. Use fields (e.g. 'id,home,away,date') and limit to keep the list short. Score periods use keys p1..pN, ft, ot and ap (older keys period1, overtime, penalties, fulltime stop on 12 November 2026).

bookmaker.description: Only return events with odds from this bookmaker (e.g. 'Bet365')

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (max 5000)

participantId.description: Filter by participant/team ID (matches home or away)

skip.description: Number of events to skip for pagination

status.description: One status or a comma-separated list: pending, live, settled, cancelled

to.description: End date/time in RFC3339 format. Defaults to 14 days from now

name: get_events
title: List events
